manifest.name: convert_currency_to_czk_cnb
manifest.description: Converts an amount in any currency to CZK using the current official ČNB daily exchange rate.
manifest.purpose: a bot that converts an amount in any currency to CZK at today's official ČNB exchange rate
manifest.headline: {amount} {currency} is {czk} CZK at the ČNB rate of {rate_date} ({rate} CZK per {unit_amount} {currency}).
examples: How much is 250 EUR in Czech crowns?
What is 5000 JPY worth in CZK today?
manifest.manual_basis: Look up current ČNB exchange rate for the currency, then multiply the amount by the rate to convert to CZK.
